name: UIPod
description: An iPod-inspired offline, Navidrome & Jellyfin media player for the TrimUI Brick/Hammer with GPU UI and visualizations.
author: famiclone

changelog.v0.10.2:
- Added DJ Mixer under Extras -> Plugins with live Dual-Deck mixing, 4-beat discrete bar waveforms, seamless playlist handoff, crossfader Bass Swap, bipolar LPF/HPF DJ filter, RAM Cue/Stutter, 4/2/1/0.5 Beat Loops, Master Tempo/Vinyl Beat Sync, and Quick Track Loader
- Added Y-button quick Audio Visualizer toggle on Now Playing (Y or B returns to Now Playing) and Invert Visualizer palette toggle in Settings -> Appearance and Visualizer MENU options
- Refined Cassette Deck visualizer with compact TDK-style flush slotted reel clamps, lowered head-shield housing, top-only corner screws, a distinct 8-segment peak zone on the stereo L/R LED meter, and stronger stereo VU/PPM meter calibration
- Attenuated Tape Mode fast-forward / rewind motor whir volume (-8 dB) for smoother seeking and synced 1:1 v0.10.2 parity across TrimUI Brick, Android, and the WebAssembly simulator
changelog.v0.10.1:
- Eliminated ~10-second freezes when opening .epub, .fb2 / .fb2.zip, and .mobi books via lazy single-chapter opening (<150ms cold) and persistent SD-card binary book index caching (<20ms warm re-open)
- Eliminated ~10-second freezes when switching Font Size, Font Family (Geologica Sans <-> Noto Serif), or Paginated <-> Scroll mode (<30ms) with lock-free O(1) glyph advance lookup tables and active-chapter pagination
- Fixed background music cutouts and stutters while opening books, flipping chapters, decoding cover art, or resizing fonts by offloading archive/chapter indexing to a background OS worker thread with cooperative scheduler yields
- Added a two-tier 8 MB LRU grayscale & 4-shade dithered illustration cache so font resizes and mode switches never re-decode embedded JPEG/PNG images, synced across TrimUI Brick, Android, and the WebAssembly simulator
changelog.v0.10.0:
- Upgraded Text Viewer into a 4-shade E-Book & Document Reader supporting .epub, .fb2 / .fb2.zip (UTF-8 & Windows-1251), DRM-free .mobi, .md, and .txt with Bayer-dithered covers & illustrations, interactive Footnote popup cards, and navigable Chapters (TOC)
- Added switchable book typography (Geologica Sans <-> Noto Serif) in Reader Options (MENU / Hold A), SELECT Paginated <-> Scroll mode toggle at the exact reading spot, Hide UI top-bar toggle, permanent full-width bottom progress strip (% or READ / TOTAL pages), and background music controls
- Bundled Pan-CJK + full Ukrainian Cyrillic vector fonts (NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttf and Noto Serif Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic + NotoSerifCJK-Regular.ttf) for crisp Latin, Slavic/Ukrainian, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean rendering
- Hardened .epub opening from Browse with VFS-to-host path resolution, UTF-8 entity & relative manifest normalization, DRM detection with non-blocking HUD error toasts, and 1:1 WebAssembly simulator parity
changelog.v0.9.2:
- Fixed mid-track forward skips, clipped track endings, stuck 0:00 crossfade countdowns, and ~500ms track-switch audio dropouts with lock-safe ring commits, full EOF tail draining, latency-accurate Dual-Deck playhead & midpoint handoff, and sub-20ms anti-click track splicing
- Added Direct DAC (hw:0,0) hardware ALSA output and 3.5mm Low-Shelf (Subtle / Warm / Deep) wired headphone bass compensation in Settings -> Sound
- Added Beat Stack music-synced Stack Attack × Lumines rhythm-puzzle game under Extras -> Plugins and unified background BPM/beat-grid track intelligence across DJ Crossfade, Sound Racer, Pulsar Vanguard, and Beat Stack
- Added Noto Sans JP CJK vector font fallback for Japanese, Chinese, and Korean metadata, synced 1:1 v0.9.2 parity in the WebAssembly simulator, and fixed wasm-pack release packaging
changelog.v0.9.1:
- Fixed mid-track forward skips, clipped track endings, stuck 0:00 crossfade countdowns, and ~500ms track-switch audio dropouts with lock-safe ring commits, full EOF tail draining, latency-accurate Dual-Deck playhead & midpoint handoff, and sub-20ms anti-click track splicing
- Added Direct DAC (hw:0,0) hardware ALSA output and 3.5mm Low-Shelf (Subtle / Warm / Deep) wired headphone bass compensation in Settings -> Sound
- Added Beat Stack music-synced Stack Attack × Lumines rhythm-puzzle game under Extras -> Plugins and unified background BPM/beat-grid track intelligence across DJ Crossfade, Sound Racer, Pulsar Vanguard, and Beat Stack
- Added Noto Sans JP CJK vector font fallback for Japanese, Chinese, and Korean metadata and synced 1:1 v0.9.1 parity in the WebAssembly simulator
changelog.v0.9.0:
- Added Unified Stacked HUD overlay system with choreographed floating cards for Volume, multi-line Toasts, live Progress bars, and non-destructive Confirmation dialogs across Firmware, Android, and WebAssembly
- Migrated all remaining video HUD, .srt subtitle, Hold lock, and message screens to crisp vector Geologica typography and pruned ~42 MB of legacy bitmap fonts from TrimUI Brick .pak and Android .apk packages
- Hardened ListenBrainz authentication and endpoint handling with automatic token sanitization (stripping quotes, whitespace, and scheme prefixes) and canonical API URL normalization
- Synced 1:1 Stacked HUD confirmation, progress, and toast behavior in the WebAssembly simulator
changelog.v0.8.2:
- Fixed Video Settings context menu (Hold A / MENU) input freeze and flicker-free GPU overlay transition during active video playback, with reliable pause/resume and clean Hold-button release handling
- Hardened hardware video player (tplayerslave / ffprobe / ffmpeg) child process lifecycle with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, FD_CLOEXEC, and orphan cleanup so background video processes never outlive UIPod
- Synced 1:1 Video Settings (Aspect Fit, Audio Track, Subtitles) and EN/UA localization parity in the WebAssembly simulator, and hardened deploy-brick.sh process termination & auto-repackaging
changelog.v0.8.1:
- Replaced the legacy blocking "Nothing to resume" modal with a non-blocking floating HUD toast that keeps the active menu cursor intact
- Unified Volume and toast HUD overlays in uipod-ui with shared backdrop/border styling, smooth top-slide entrance/exit curves, and jitter-free timer coexistence across Firmware and WebAssembly
changelog.v0.8.0:
- Added pure-Rust ListenBrainz scrobbling client (Settings -> Accounts -> ListenBrainz) with User Token validation, custom Server URL support for self-hosted Maloja/Koito instances, live Now Playing status, and local/chiptune/streaming scrobbling
- Added independent persistent offline scrobble queue (listenbrainz_queue.tsv) with batched import uploads, exponential retry backoff, and automatic malformed-record isolation so Last.fm and ListenBrainz scrobble concurrently without blocking each other
- Updated Settings -> Accounts with live right-aligned connection status summaries (@username, Signed in, Invalid token, Off) for both Last.fm and ListenBrainz, plus full English/Ukrainian localization and 1:1 WebAssembly simulator parity
changelog.v0.7.0:
- Added Dual-Deck Smart DJ Crossfade engine (Settings -> Sound -> Crossfade & Auto-DJ) with Classic, DJ Vinyl, and pitch-preserving WSOLA DJ Master Tempo modes, center-phrase Bass Swap, Filter Wash fallback, Album Gapless protection, Quick Cut on Next (R1), and live Now Playing telemetry pill
- Added pure-Rust .nsf/.nsfe NES/Famicom chiptune engine (2A03 + VRC6 + MMC5) with Music/SFX subtrack browser, live Now Playing APU channel telemetry, interactive Hold A -> Channels mute/solo mixer, Endless Loop toggle, and native tick-rate DJ tempo sync
- Added pure-Rust .gsf/.minigsf GBA Sound Format and .mid/.midi/.kar/.rmi MIDI synthesis with built-in Mobile_0100_base.sf2 and custom .sf2 SoundFont selection (Settings -> Library -> SoundFont Folders & Hold A -> SoundFont)
- Added Pulsar Vanguard cosmic music-synced shooter under Extras -> Plugins with 1/4 Beat Pulse, 1/1 Wave Cannon, 1/8 Focus Vulcan auto-fire, and on-beat Perfect Phase EMP dash
- Eliminated audio dropouts when turning the TrimUI Brick display off/on and synced full 1:1 DJ Crossfade, chiptune/MIDI, and plugin parity in the WebAssembly simulator
changelog.v0.6.0:
- Added pure-Rust Last.fm Scrobbling 2.0 client (Settings -> Accounts -> Last.fm) with on-screen QR Code Sign-In, real-time Now Playing updates, and persistent offline scrobble queue
- Expanded Settings -> Sound -> Effects into a full stereo DSP suite with Reverb, Ping-Pong Delay, Chorus, Flanger, master Enable Effects switch, Now Playing quick toggle, and header FX indicator
- Added GPU-rendered 10-band Graphic Equalizer screen with Preamp + vertical band faders and instant X-button Bypass
- Added Video Settings menu in the video player (Hold A / MENU) with Aspect Mode (Fit / Crop / Stretch), multi-track Audio Track switching, and external .srt Subtitles
- Synced 1:1 firmware parity in the WebAssembly browser simulator and automated parallel GitHub Actions release builds for TrimUI Brick (.pak), Android (arm64 APK), and GitHub Pages
changelog.v0.5.0:
- Added native Android (arm64-v8a) port for retro handhelds with low-latency AAudio/SDL2 audio, hardware MediaPlayer video layer, physical gamepad + Menu & volume rocker mapping, and background playback service
- Added dynamic native-HiDPI multi-screen responsive layout (16:9, 16:10, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, and portrait) with zero-readback GPU rendering, GPU-to-GPU transitions, and aspect-adaptive 4-shade visualizers
- Extended native plugin SDK (v6) with responsive full-screen canvas support for Text Viewer, Stopwatch, and Music Quiz while keeping arcade board games aspect-preserved at native sharpness
- Upgraded interactive WebAssembly studio with TrimUI Brick & Android installation guides and expanded built-in Y2K / Jungle demo library
changelog.v0.4.0:
- Added Settings -> Sound -> Effects with Ableton Texture-style granular Speed time-stretching (1/16x–1.5x) and Walkman Tape Mode emulation (Wow & Flutter, Hiss, Crinkles, Saturation, HF Roll-Off, Pause spin-down/up, and FF/Rewind motor sound)
- Added Cassette Deck (spinning spools + 28-segment LED meter) and centered Analog Stereo VU Meter 4-shade GPU visualizers, tightened audio/vsync latency sync, and updated visualizer controls (Left/Right to skip or hold to seek, L2/R2 to switch presets)
- Added Music Quiz local library game under Extras -> Plugins and upgraded Sound Racer with .nsf / chiptune support and drift-free highway sync
- Promoted Browse to the first Main Menu entry with persistent last-opened folder memory and file management context menu (Delete, Rename, Copy, Move, and Info via Text Viewer)
changelog.v0.3.0:
- Added native Rust (.uipod) plugin runtime & SDK under Extras -> Plugins with 5 games (Sound Racer, Tetris, Snake, Brick Breaker, 2048), Stopwatch, LCD Plasma, and Text Viewer
- Replaced Milkdrop with a native 4-shade Bayer-dithered OpenGL ES audio visualizer engine (8 presets synced to speaker & Bluetooth output latency)
- Added low-latency iPod Click Wheel menu navigation sound with a Menu Click toggle in Settings -> Sound
- Added interactive in-app manual in Settings -> About (opened via Text Viewer) and streamlined Sound, Extras, and Settings menus
- Removed legacy unused code and C++ projectM dependencies, reducing package size and memory footprint
changelog.v0.2.0:
- Unified multi-source library merging local folders, Navidrome, and Jellyfin without duplicates, plus Navidrome Favourites playlist and Offline Mode
- Non-blocking persistent Downloads queue with header DONE/TOTAL progress and 3-by-3 sliding-window playback queue prefetching
- Updated 4-shade iPod Mini theme system (bg, fg, fg1, fg2) with 4-shade monochrome album art and live HEX Customize Theme editor
- Added 6 selectable screen transitions (Slide, Cover, Fade, Pixels, Blinds, Off) in Settings -> Display
- Redesigned GPU-rendered QWERTY on-screen keyboard and fixed folder back-navigation stability
changelog.v0.1.3: - Renamed packaged runtime directory and main executable inside UIPod.pak from trimpod to uipod (with automatic config path migration on launch)
changelog.v0.1.2:
- Monochrome album art now renders in 3 shades of the active theme palette with ordered Bayer dithering
- Unified UIPod naming across Rust crates and C application modules
changelog.v0.1.1: - Added UIPod Classic Dark theme (#1E1B1C / #D6D8D5) in Settings -> Display -> Theme
changelog.v0.1.0:
- Native 1024x768 HiDPI pure-Rust UI (uipod-ui) with Geologica typography
- English & Ukrainian localization
- Navidrome / Subsonic music streaming, caching & offline downloads (/mnt/SDCARD/Media/Music/navidrome)
- Jellyfin video (Movies, TV Shows) & audio streaming with automatic H.264/AAC transcoding and offline downloads (/mnt/SDCARD/Media/Videos/jellyfin)
- Built-in AutoEQ headphone database & 10-band parametric EQ
- 100 Milkdrop GPU visualizers via projectM
